description: Pilot topics for the hybrid-search retrieval benchmark. Each topic is a published systematic review or meta-analysis in PubMed Central. Gold records are the primary studies in its PubMed reference list, fetched live; they are a proxy for the review's included studies because a reference list also holds background citations. Queries were written from the review question alone, before any gold record was seen.

topics.question: remimazolam versus propofol for general anaesthesia in elderly patients hypotension recovery
topics.pubmed_query: remimazolam[tiab] AND "Propofol"[Mesh] AND ("Aged"[Mesh] OR elderly[tiab] OR older[tiab]) AND "Anesthesia, General"[Mesh]

topics.question: sugammadex versus neostigmine postoperative pulmonary complications pneumonia respiratory failure
topics.pubmed_query: ("Sugammadex"[Mesh] OR sugammadex[tiab]) AND ("Neostigmine"[Mesh] OR neostigmine[tiab]) AND ("Postoperative Complications"[Mesh] OR pulmonary complications[tiab] OR pneumonia[tiab])

topics.question: intra-articular versus intravenous tranexamic acid in primary total knee arthroplasty blood loss
topics.pubmed_query: "Tranexamic Acid"[Mesh] AND "Arthroplasty, Replacement, Knee"[Mesh] AND (intra-articular[tiab] OR topical[tiab]) AND intravenous[tiab]

topics.question: esketamine postoperative delirium and cognitive dysfunction in adult surgical patients under general anaesthesia
topics.pubmed_query: (esketamine[tiab] OR "S-ketamine"[tiab]) AND ("Postoperative Cognitive Complications"[Mesh] OR "Emergence Delirium"[Mesh] OR "Delirium"[Mesh] OR postoperative delirium[tiab] OR cognitive dysfunction[tiab])

topics.question: erector spinae plane block analgesia after breast cancer surgery opioid consumption
topics.pubmed_query: erector spinae plane block[tiab] AND ("Breast Neoplasms"[Mesh] OR "Mastectomy"[Mesh] OR breast surgery[tiab])

topics.question: balanced crystalloids saline albumin hydroxyethyl starch fluid resuscitation mortality in sepsis surgery and trauma
topics.pubmed_query: ("Crystalloid Solutions"[Mesh] OR balanced crystalloid[tiab] OR "Saline Solution"[Mesh] OR albumin[tiab] OR "Hydroxyethyl Starch Derivatives"[Mesh]) AND "Fluid Therapy"[Mesh] AND ("Sepsis"[Mesh] OR "Critical Illness"[Mesh] OR "Wounds and Injuries"[Mesh]) AND (mortality[tiab] OR "Mortality"[Mesh])
